movie_title: What is the manosphere? ⏲️ 6 Minute English
introduction: Have you ever come across a so-called masculinity influencer on social media? ⭐ Find a free transcri

vocabulary.definition: qualities or attributes regarded as characteristic of men
vocabulary.example: The manosphere promotes toxic masculinity and unrealistic expectations of manhood.

vocabulary.definition: individuals who have the power to affect purchase decisions of others because of their authority, knowledge, position, or relationship with their audience
vocabulary.example: Many young men are influenced by social media influencers who promote harmful ideas about masculinity.

vocabulary.definition: advocating for or implementing social reform or new, liberal ideas
vocabulary.example: Will realized that the manosphere's views were harmful and regressive, not progressive.

vocabulary.definition: easily hurt physically or emotionally; open to attack, harm, or damage
vocabulary.example: Will felt vulnerable when he was targeted by those promoting toxic masculinity ideals.

vocabulary.definition: to control or supervise by means of rules and regulations
vocabulary.example: It's important to regulate online content to prevent the spread of harmful ideologies like those found in the manosphere.

vocabulary.definition: a sudden failure of mental or physical health; a collapse
vocabulary.example: After years of following the manosphere, Will experienced a mental breakdown due to the toxic ideologies he had internalized.
